summary_en: Nisshin Seifun Group authorized the acquisition of up to 14.00 million shares, representing 5.00% of outstanding shares, for a maximum total of 20.0 billion yen through market purchases via a trust arrangement over the period from November 2, 2026 to June 23, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Nisshin Seifun Group Inc. announced a share repurchase authorization approved by its board of directors. The company is authorized to acquire up to 14.00 million ordinary shares, equivalent to 5.00% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026: 279,751,520 shares), for a maximum total expenditure of 20.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases via a trust arrangement scheme over the period from November 2, 2026 to June 23, 2027.

The company stated that the repurchase program aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while implementing capital policies appropriate to the prevailing business environment. The disclosure notes that partial or full acquisition may not occur depending on investment opportunities and market conditions.
